tools.game_control.parameters.dialog: Dialog kind for uiDomain=dialog. Only mod_mismatch is supported; unrelated dialogs cannot be acknowledged.
tools.game_control.parameters.dialogToke: Opaque token returned by status for the current MOD mismatch dialog. Required for acknowledge and checked again before native invocation.
ui_dialog.ui_control_description: Unified UI entrypoint: domain=action/feedback/dialog/selection. Supports allowed UI actions, player feedback, native dialog status/acknowledge, and exact-id duplicant selection status/select/close/scroll_up/scroll_down.
ui_dialog.ui_domain_description: UI subsystem: action, feedback, dialog or selection.
ui_dialog.ui_action_description: domain=action: list/trigger/open_management; domain=feedback: notification/popup/speech_bubble/marker; domain=dialog: status/acknowledge; domain=selection: passive status or explicit select/close/scroll_up/scroll_down with exact id. Selection UI mutations require task and confirm=true; dryRun invokes no UI. Scroll requires the selected duplicant UI; scroll_up/down dispatches one native wheel event (+1/-1) and returns pending, without guaranteeing distance, completion or visibility. Request a later status or screenshot explicitly.
ui_dialog.invalid_ui_domain: UI domain must be action, feedback, dialog or selection.
tools.game_control.parameters.keepPaused: For MOD mismatch acknowledgement, preserve a paused game after native OK; defaults to true. False leaves native pause handling unchanged and never forces resume. Status and dryRun do not change speed.
ui_dialog.unsupported_action: Dialog action must be status or acknowledge.
ui_dialog.unsupported_dialog: Only the mod_mismatch dialog is supported.
ui_dialog.token_required: Read the current dialog status and pass its dialogToken before acknowledging.
ui_dialog.token_stale: The dialog token no longer matches the visible MOD mismatch dialog. Read status again.
ui_dialog.confirm_required: confirm=true is required to acknowledge the MOD mismatch dialog.
ui_dialog.unavailable: The native MOD mismatch dialog UI is unavailable.
ui_dialog.ambiguous: More than one current MOD mismatch dialog was found; the target is ambiguous.
ui_dialog.blocked: Native UI input is disabled, or another dialog is in front of the MOD mismatch dialog.
ui_dialog.button_unavailable: The native OK button is not ready for invocation.
ui_dialog.unsupported_shape: The current dialog does not match the supported MOD mismatch confirmation layout.
ui_dialog.pause_unavailable: Native pause control is unavailable; a paused result cannot be preserved.
ui_dialog.not_present: No MOD mismatch dialog is currently visible.
ui_dialog.invalid_boolean: Parameter `{0}` must be a JSON boolean.
ui_selection.unavailable: The native duplicant selection UI cannot be observed in the current state. See reasonCode.
ui_selection.pending: The native duplicant selection UI has not finished updating. No UI refresh was forced.
ui_selection.native_failed: The native UI operation was invoked, but its final state is not confirmed. Inspect status before retrying.
ui_selection.invalid_request: The duplicant selection request is invalid. See reasonCode and parameter.
